items.title: Italian Language Week at the National Library of Georgia
items.description: (ANSA) - MOSCA, 14 OTT - The first event celebrating the 26th Week of the Italian Language in the World took place at the historic National Library of Georgia. items.title: Somalia national intelligence agency abducts journalist reporting on security tensions in Mogadishu
items.description: At midday on Sunday, plainclothes NISA officers abducted journalist Khadar Abdirahim Ibrahim of Himilo Media in Mogadishu, according to his colleagues. Khadar was on his lunch break when NISA officers approached him at a restaurant near Himilo Media's offices in the Wadajir district of Mogadishu. A colleague who spoke to SJS said that was the last time they saw him. items.title: Egypt to build a rail link as an alternative to the blocked Suez Canal
items.description: Dubbed the "Suez Canal on Rails", the line connects Red Sea ports directly to Mediterranean export terminals. Once fully operational, it is expected to carry up to 13 million tonnes of freight each year, allowing cargo to be transferred across Egypt by rail and helping bypass maritime bottlenecks.
items.titleIt: Egypt to build a rail link as an alternative to the blocked Suez Canal

items.title: Sudan: WFP Strongly Condemns Attack On Trucks In South Kordofan, Killing One Driver
items.description: One driver was killed in the air strike. We extend our deepest condolences to his family, friends and colleagues. The contracted trucks were en route from Dilling to Kadugli and clearly marked as humanitarian vehicles. Additional details regarding the circumstances of the incident, including the extent of the damage to the food cargo, are still being collected. WFP calls for a prompt and impartial investigation into this incident and for those responsible for any violations to be held accountable.
